description: This file defines an Android activity called ColorFilters that demonstrates the use of color filters with drawables and painting in Canvas. It includes an inner View subclass that manages drawing colored images and applying PorterDuff color filters, responding to touch events to change blending modes and paint colors.

classes.name: ColorFilters
classes.description: Main activity class that sets up the demonstration and contains the inner SampleView class.

classes.name: ColorFilters.SampleView
classes.description: Custom View displaying drawables with different color filters applied, handling user interaction to change blending mode and paint colors.

methods.name: ColorFilters.onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the content view to an instance of SampleView.

methods.name: ColorFilters.SampleView.constructor
methods.description: Initializes the custom view, loads drawable resources, sets up paints, colors, and modes for the demonstration.

methods.name: ColorFilters.SampleView.addToTheRight
methods.description: Positions a drawable to the right of another for layout purposes.

methods.name: ColorFilters.SampleView.swapPaintColors
methods.description: Swaps the paint and paint2 colors between black and white.

methods.name: ColorFilters.SampleView.updateTitle
methods.description: Updates the activity title to show the current PorterDuff mode.

methods.name: ColorFilters.SampleView.drawSample
methods.description: Draws a drawable with a specified color filter and overlays text.

methods.name: ColorFilters.SampleView.onDraw
methods.description: Handles drawing the entire view, including multiple color-filtered drawables.

methods.name: ColorFilters.SampleView.onTouchEvent
methods.description: Handles touch events to cycle blending modes and swap paint colors.
